title: Mass of the Americas
label: Cappella Records, CR-425
blurb: Benedict XVI Choir and Orchestra, Richard Sparks, conductor. Produced by multi-Grammy-winning producer Blanton Alspaugh and Soundmirror. Sung in Latin, Spanish, and Nahuatl. Debuted at number one on the Billboard Traditional Classical chart.

title: Requiem for the Forgotten · Messe des Malades
label: Cappella Records, CR-430
blurb: Benedict XVI Choir and Orchestra, Richard Sparks, conductor. The Requiem commemorates the displaced and the homeless; the Messe des Malades was inspired by the composer's late sister Carin.

title: In This Place
label: Enharmonic Records
blurb: Frank La Rocca's debut solo CD with the Artists Vocal Ensemble. A 2013 Critic's Choice at American Record Guide; reached the top ten in classical CD sales on Amazon.
